summary_en: Makita authorized acquisition of up to 10.0 million shares (3.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 40.0 billion yen between November 2, 2026 and March 31, 2027, to support flexible capital allocation toward achieving its 2030 vision.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decisions on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, Makita's Board of Directors resolved to authorize the acquisition of treasury stock based on Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and the company's Articles of Incorporation. The authorization permits the acquisition of up to 10.0 million shares, representing 3.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate price of 4.0 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from November 2, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

The company stated the purpose of this buyback authorization is to support flexible capital allocation in pursuit of achieving its stated vision for fiscal year 2030. As of September 30, 2026, Makita held 22.4 million treasury shares against 257.7 million issued shares excluding treasury stock.
